One of the Top Menus in Da Nang
Aug 2026 • Couples
From start to finish, one of the best meals I’ve had in Da Nang. We sat outside, and the view was stunning. However, there’s something delightfully off about the disconnect between what you’re eating and the environment you’re eating it in. It feels like a brunch club, daytime-party spot — like The Gypsy took over the rooftop of this hotel without much thought on decor and music. Anyway, THE FOOD… exceptional, elevated, and every dish felt considered — you’re in for one of the best meals in the city! Come! I’ll be going again soon! <3

We are absolutely thrilled that the meal hit the mark for you and that you rank it among the best in Da Nang! Our team puts immense passion into crafting elevated, thoughtful dishes, so hearing that the food truly blew you away means everything to us.

We also really appreciate your honest take on the rooftop energy and decor. **The Gypsy Da Nang** was envisioned to blend an approachable, high-energy party atmosphere with high-end culinary standards, but feedback like yours helps us continuously refine the overall guest experience, music, and setting.
